newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Islamists invite Farrakhan to congress.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Islamists invite Farrakhan to congress.

text.p: The Islamist Welfare Party of Turkey's Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan has invited U.S. militant black Muslim leader Louis Farrakhan to its annual congress at the weekend, Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.
Among the 320 foreign guests invited to the congress was also ousted Afghanistan prime minister Gulbuddin Hekmatyar, the agency said.
It did not say whether either had accepted the invitation to the congress, being held in Ankara on Sunday.

Welfare prepared for the occasion amid opposition and media attacks on party leader Erbakan's visit to Libya at the weekend. Libyan leader Muammer Gaddafi had strongly criticised Ankara's treatment of its Kurds at a joint news conference.

Around 1,100 Welfare Party delegates are expected to take part in the meeting, which will be the first major gathering of the party since it came to power in coalition with conservatives three months ago.
